name: GATE-COLLAPSE-the-sealed-hours-count-nothing
old:
if (phase === 'closed') return { to: 'collapse', ms: Math.max(0, t.wrathAt - nowMs) };
  return null;

name: GATE-COLLAPSE-counted-to-the-seal-again
old: if (phase === 'closed') return { to: 'collapse', ms: Math.max(0, t.wrathAt - nowMs) };
new: if (phase === 'closed') return { to: 'collapse', ms: Math.max(0, t.sealAt - nowMs) };

name: GATE-COLLAPSE-the-seal-line-at-the-seal's-time
old: sayOf(sealTimeLine({ ...words, at: at(t.day, GATE_WRATH_MINUTE) })); // GATE-COLLAPSE: and when it goes
new: sayOf(sealTimeLine({ ...words, at: at(t.day, GATE_SEAL_MINUTE) })); // GATE-COLLAPSE: and when it goes

name: GATE-COLLAPSE-the-map-forgets-it-sealed
old:
const label = cd
        ? `Dagon's Breach - ${cd.to === 'collapse' ? 'sealed, ' : ''}${countdownWords(cd)}`
        : "Dagon's Breach"; // GATE-COLLAPSE: the sealed hours count down too
new: const label = cd ? `Dagon's Breach - ${countdownWords(cd)}` : "Dagon's Breach"; // GATE-COLLAPSE: the sealed hours count down too

name: GATE-COLLAPSE-the-banner-forgets-it-sealed
old: banner(cd ? `${GATE_TEXT.name} - ${cd.to === 'collapse' ? 'sealed, ' : ''}${countdownWords(cd)}` : null); // GATE-COLLAPSE: the sealed hours count down to the collapse
new: banner(cd ? `${GATE_TEXT.name} - ${countdownWords(cd)}` : null); // GATE-COLLAPSE: the sealed hours count down to the collapse

name: GATE-COLLAPSE-the-plaque-forgets-it-sealed
new: return { title: GATE_TEXT.name, subs: words ? [...[], words[0].toUpperCase() + words.slice(1)] : [] }; // GATE-COLLAPSE: sealed, and when it goes
